submitted.body:
The counterinstance is the projective plane PG(2,5), threshold 5, with synchronous updates and inclusion-minimality. The proof reduces minimality to closed deletion separators, normalizes a noncollinear triple, and checks a reverse-unit-propagation refutation of the finite formula. The paper specifies the geometric-to-Boolean bridge and the unconditional Lean endpoint. This refutes the read arXiv statement; the journal version was not read.

**Result and scope:** Conjecture 20 fails at the allowed boundary (q,r) = (5,5): in PG(2,5) no inclusion-minimal percolating set has percolation time 2 at threshold 5.

**Complete proof and verification sources:** [No two-round minimal line-percolating set in PG(2,5): a counterexample to Conjecture 20 of Gerbner-Keszegh-Meszaros-Patkos-Vizer (arXiv:1608.00531)](https://mathdb.com/abs/2611.00058) · [PDF](https://mathdb.com/pdf/2611.00058v1).

The paper page includes the supplementary proof-source JSON attachments (download all three parts) and `extract_sources.py`, which reconstruct the archived proof and verification sources. The linked paper gives the complete rigorous argument and specifies exactly which statements are formalized.

This is an AI-assisted research preprint. Internal review is not external journal peer review; bounded prior-art searches do not certify worldwide priority. See the paper for the source, interpretation, formalization, and trust limitations.
